- [**3D Pinball — Space Cadet: a Nintendo DS port of the decompilation**](https://github.com/headshot2017/3dpinball-nds) - 3dpinball-nds adapts the Space Cadet Pinball decompilation into a Nintendo DS port built with BlocksDS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/3dpinball-nds-case/)</sub>
